text:
Lucas Park: Hey folks — Lucas here, starting Monday. Trying to find the Product playbooks and onboarding templates in Notion but I only get read-only. Who owns the templates and how do I get edit access? Also want to duplicate the 'PR Postmortem' template into my personal workspace. Thx! :wave:

Diah Nguyen: Welcome Lucas! Product playbooks live in the Notion workspace: Redwood > Product > Playbooks. Quick link (example): https://redwood.notion.so/product-playbooks.
Edit access is granted by the docs-editors group. Please ping @devex with the page URL + reason and they can add you.

docs-bot: Reminder: when requesting edit access include the full page URL, your role, and what you'll change. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk or DM @devex.

Maya Chen: Steps I usually follow to duplicate and set ownership:
1) Open the template page, click ••• (top-right) -> Duplicate.
2) In left sidebar, drag the duplicated page into "My workspace" or use "Move to" -> My workspace.
3) Edit page properties: add an "Owner" property (type: Person) and populate it.

Example page url pattern:```https://redwood.notion.so/<workspace>/<page-title>-<page-id>```

Lucas Park: Thanks! If I duplicate the template, will the properties (Owner, Status) carry over? And how do I make the Owner field show up in the template itself so everyone who duplicates remembers to set it?

Olivia Park: Properties do carry over if you duplicate the page template. To ensure the Owner field is visible by default: Open the template, click "Configure template" (or edit the template page), then: Properties -> + Add a property -> name it "Owner" -> Type: Person. Optionally add a property description like "Assign the person responsible for this doc." Save the template. Everyone who duplicates will see the Owner property.

Samir Patel: One extra note — if you need to edit the canonical Playbook (not just a copy), request the "Editor" role on that page (commenter/read-only won't let you change templates). When you ping @devex include the canonical page link and say "please add Editor to Lucas Park for Product Playbooks". :thumbsup:

Lucas Park: Awesome, that helps a lot. I'll duplicate the PR Postmortem, add the Owner property, and ping @devex if I need editor rights on the canonical page. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
